newsitem.title: USA: ContiFinancial buys stake in mortgage co.
newsitem.headline: ContiFinancial buys stake in mortgage co.

text.p: ContiFinancial Corp said Monday it acquired a 35 percent equity interest in GateCapital LLC, a new company headquartered in San Francisco, for an undisclosed purchase price.

Contifinancial said GateCapital will originate and service commercial real estate mortgage loans that will be securitized through ContiFinancial's commercial mortgage program. GateCapital will also originate and service highly-leveraged and other commercial mortgage loans for third parties.
The remaining 65 percent of GateCapital is owned by its three managers, James Flaherty, William Hatch and F. James Kehoe, ContiFinancial said in a statement.
ContiFinancial Corp is a consumer and commercial finance company.
